svg.aria-label: The /persona-audit workflow: a diff or full-tree scope fans out to isolated read-only reviewer personas running five at a time, their findings are deduplicated and reconciled by an adjudicator, the human triages each finding as accept, reject, or defer (or fixes one immediately with F), up to three fix agents apply accepted fixes in parallel, and a verifier judges every fix and runs the project's check, lint, and test gate — passing to a written report, or looping gate failures back to a repair agent for up to three rounds
svg.text: expert personas review in parallel · one adjudicator reconciles · you triage · every fix is verified
gate failures go to a repair agent
reviewers never see each other · every finding is your decision · deferred findings land in a handoff you can resume later
